prompt: Take apart a single stack trace frame so a tool can show where the code was. Complete StackFrameParser, then run the tests.
explanation: Every frame has the same shape, so one private head() helper normalises the line -- drop the indentation, drop the "at " prefix, cut everything from the '(' -- and the class and method are then just the two halves either side of the LAST dot. Using lastIndexOf is essential: the package itself contains dots, so indexOf would stop at "com". The line number lives inside the parentheses after a ':', and validating that the text there is all digits is what turns "(Native Method)" into -1 instead of a NumberFormatException.
hints: Write one private helper that trims the line, removes a leading "at ", and cuts off everything from the '(' onwards.
Split that head at lastIndexOf('.') -- indexOf would stop at the first package segment.
For the line number, look between '(' and ')' for a ':'; check every character after it is a digit before calling Integer.parseInt.
